summaryDeep: Their confidence, encouragement, and appetite for possibility work smoothly with your affections, tastes, and sense of worth. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
tension: A relationship can feel good and still need attention, effort, and honest conversation to keep moving forward.
advice: Enjoy the vibe and everything that flows easily between you, but don't just coast on it. Keep showing up, keep putting something into it. The connections that last are the ones people choose again and again, not just the ones that start out easy.
